title: MLB Statcast 2021-2023 Pitch Subset
subtitle: Every regular-season MLB pitch 2021-2023, 23 Statcast columns
description:
# MLB Statcast 2021-2023 Pitch Subset

Every pitch of the **2021, 2022 and 2023 MLB regular seasons** from Baseball Savant (one request per day, regular-season games only), one row per pitch, with the 23 columns read by the pre-registered pitcher studies in [kaggle-datasets](https://github.com/yasumorishima/kaggle-datasets). This dataset is the input of a pre-registered confirmatory test that runs the frozen code of the pitcher spin-axis gap study (commit `e83a56e`) on seasons no study had read. The files are built and checked by `pitcher-confirm-statcast-2021-2023/build.py` in that repository; their md5 sums are recorded in the freeze file.

## Files

| File | Rows | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `statcast_2021.parquet` | {rows:statcast_2021} | Every 2021 regular-season pitch |
| `statcast_2022.parquet` | {rows:statcast_2022} | Every 2022 regular-season pitch |
| `statcast_2023.parquet` | {rows:statcast_2023} | Every 2023 regular-season pitch |
| `tracking_gaps.csv` | {rows:tracking_gaps} | Games where a pitch-tracking column is empty for the whole game or below its fill floor (permanent gaps in Savant's data) |

## Columns (all three Parquet files)

`pitcher`, `game_date`, `game_pk`, `at_bat_number`, `pitch_number`, `pitch_type`, `release_speed`, `release_spin_rate`, `release_extension`, `release_pos_x`, `release_pos_z`, `arm_angle`, `pfx_x`, `pfx_z`, `zone`, `description`, `events`, `type`, `launch_speed`, `woba_denom`, `inning`, `game_type`, `spin_axis`.

Names, units and types are Baseball Savant's (see the [Statcast search CSV documentation](https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/csv-docs)); the Arrow types are those of [MLB Statcast + Bat Tracking (2024-2026)](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/yasunorim/mlb-statcast-bat-tracking-2024-2025). Rows whose `description` is `automatic_ball` or `automatic_strike` are balls and strikes awarded without a pitch (no tracking columns). A pitch is identified by (`game_pk`, `at_bat_number`, `pitch_number`).

## Source and license

Data: [Baseball Savant](https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/) (MLB Advanced Media) and [MLB StatsAPI](https://statsapi.mlb.com/) (regular-season schedule). Use of MLB data is subject to MLB's terms. Packaging released under CC0.
